Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates multiple, well-circumscribed, round opacities in both lungs (two on the right, one on the left), which is a classic radiographic presentation for bilateral pulmonary hydatid cysts in children from endemic areas. This appearance distinguishes them from the irregular margins of metastases or pneumonia and the typical calcification of granulomas.
